title: Keto Algerian Tart
description: A rich and decadent keto tart with an Algerian twist, featuring a molten cocoa filling.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, combine almond meal, granulated sweetener, and melted coconut oil. Mix well.
3. Add in eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition.
4. Melt cocoa powder in the microwave or on the stovetop. Add to the bowl and mix until combined.
5. Pour in heavy cream and mix until smooth.
6. Pour the mixture into the tart shells.
7. Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the edges are set.
8. Remove from oven and let cool completely.
9. Melt molten chocolate in the microwave or on the stovetop.
10. Pour the melted chocolate over the cooled tart.
11. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.
